rules.check: At next decision cycle, confirm army supply is at least 10, workers are near 22-24, and no supply block is imminent.
rules.correction: Prioritize a defensive structure (e.g., Shield Battery) and produce a few Zealots or Stalkers from existing Gateways while continuing worker production. Keep tech buildings (e.g., Twilight Council) progressing. If bank exceeds 300 minerals, add a Gateway or start a Warp Gate upgrade.
rules.title: Maintain tech-economy tempo with early defense
rules.when: Before 5 minutes, with heavy economy/tech investment, enemy shows Reaper or Marine, and army supply is below 15.

rules.check: At next decision cycle, verify you have at least one Colossus or Archon, and that upgrades are not idle.
rules.correction: Add Colossi or Archons to complement High Templars. Ensure Forge and Twilight upgrades are progressing. If bank is high, add Gateways and produce Zealots/Stalkers to support the tech units.
rules.title: Counter bio with splash and upgrades
rules.when: After 6 minutes, enemy composition is primarily bio (Marines, Marauders, Medivacs) with heavy ground posture, and you have at least 2 bases and 3 production structures.

rules.check: At next decision cycle, confirm army supply is above 20 and bank is reduced by at least 50%.
rules.correction: Immediately convert bank into army: queue units from all Gateways, add Gateways if production is insufficient, and prioritize combat units over economy. Do not expand. If supply is blocked, build a Pylon. If enemy has air, add Stalkers or Phoenixes.
rules.title: Recover from low army and high bank
rules.when: Army supply is below 15, bank exceeds 1000 minerals and 500 gas, or predicted advantage is OverwhelmingDisadvantage.
